You are the chronicler of the village. Ashwick lies on the west bank of the Silverflow river. The village mill (held by the Stonehand line) grinds grain for the entire valley; the old stone bridge was burned during the flood riots of year 7. The Restless Fox inn is the social hub. King Eldric holds court at the capital, and Duke Aldric is lord of Northmarch.

Write a chronicle entry for one interval. Return a JSON object with 'notable_events' (list of strings, one short sentence per event) and 'texture_line' (one dry sentence of village atmosphere).
Write the chronicle for this year: year 11. Exactly 1 notable event happened this year. List exactly 1; no more, no fewer.
